test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven friends, E, F, G, H, I, J and Q, are sitting in a row facing north. Only three people sit to the left of Q. Only H sits to the right of E. Only three people sit between E and J. I sits at some place to the left of F but at some place to the right of G. How many people sit between G and F?
solution:
Given:

Seven friends, E, F, G, H, I, J, and Q, are sitting in a row facing north.

Only three people sit to the left of Q.

Only H sits to the right of E.

Only three people sit between E and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2683ad3fe3475af8efa013bc1420efc413189f2e57cf479da8190e4bc1f2dfd5.png] 

I sits at some place to the left of F but at some place to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72d04da11457301d64af43a706cb46473ea0ea5464dd98ef14228701246111de.png] 

Thus, three people sit between G and F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
